newsitem.title: USA: Perot promises to eliminate U.S. tax code, agency.
newsitem.headline: Perot promises to eliminate U.S. tax code, agency.

text.p: Reform Party presidential candidate Ross Perot reiterated his proposal to abolish the U.S. tax code and the Internal Revenue Service in a 30-minute televised political advertisement on Sunday.

"I pledge to you tonight that as your president we will get rid of the IRS and the tax code and replace them with a fair, paperless, modern system that will raise the revenues necessary to operate this great country," Perot said.

Perot, who gained 19 percent of the vote in the 1992 presidential election, is currently trailing both President Clinton and Republican challenger Bob Dole. Polls show him with the support of about 6 percent of voters questioned.
Perot first proposed getting rid of the IRS in a book published four years ago.
